verdict.rationale: The models overview documents the context window per model and has a dedicated context-windows guide. The changelog gives exact flagship limits: 1M context and 128k max output tokens. `GET /v1/models` and `GET /v1/models/{id}` also return `max_input_tokens` and `max_tokens` for each model, so precise input and output limits can be checked programmatically rather than read from marketing ranges. Missing for 10: an explicit per-model max-output table for every model in the docs (only the flagship's output cap is quoted), and no independent or hands-on confirmation that the documented limits match real behavior.
